[Section] Datasets ::: Data Representation
[source_id=54] For both data sources, Twitter and OSG with extracted threads, posts and comments are tokenized and sentence split. Each sentence is passed through Sentiment Analysis and Dialogue Act tagging. Since a post or a comment can contain multiple sentences, therefore multiple Dialogue Acts, it is represented as as a one-hot encoding, where each position represents a Dialogue Act.
[source_id=55] For Sentiment Analysis we use a lexicon-based sentiment analyser introduced by BIBREF25. For Dialogue Act tagging, on the other hand, we make use of a model trained on NPSChat corpus BIBREF22 following the approach of BIBREF26.

For Sentiment Analysis we use a lexicon-based sentiment analyser introduced by BIBREF25. For Dialogue Act tagging, on the other hand, we make use of a model trained on NPSChat corpus BIBREF22 following the approach of BIBREF26.
